data.body: marklas vs adf.py parity experiment (live corpus, rebar export 2026-08-03, 5,730 bodies): adf.py text_to_adf = 0% structured-rich / 0 marks for all constructs; marklas = 56.7% structured-rich, 99.65% idempotent round-trip (echo-safe). adf.py's 100% fidelity is trivial (translates nothing rich). Extending adf.py to parity = reimplementing marklas/mistune (prior hand-roll stalled at 90.7%). Engine decision: vendored marklas. Recorded explicit adf.py rejection in Cloud e59d. Scripts+tables in session files/parity*.py, files/parity-results.md.
